environment.scope: Local trusted GDScript fixtures; remote HTTP disabled

provenance.projectWriteApproval: MOCK: isolated fixture form accept; not a human UI confirmation

sourceBreakdown.scope: Godot process validation, repair persistence/rendering, official SDK transports, disconnect cleanup, Windows file I/O/readonly failure and forced OS process termination
Explicit fixture form accept/decline/cancel and library approval callbacks; not human UI confirmation
Checkpoint crashes, ENOSPC and second-file fault injection; actual disk exhaustion/power loss NOT_RUN
Full suite contains real engine tests, synthetic project fixtures and pure protocol/unit doubles; all required checks ran without skips

contractsVerified: Shared prepare/approve/apply/validate/commit/rollback journal is used by exact edits, dev_loop, client repair, generic file/scene writes and bounded git recovery
Approval binds complete operation set, project, transport owner and before/after hashes; MCP form is a separate trusted-client-hosted confirmation channel, not tool approved:true
Explicit operationId and expectedSha256 allow same-request idempotent replay; changed request or foreign-owner operation reuse is rejected
Cross-process lock serializes mutations; unresolved journal barrier is rechecked under the apply lock after approval waits
Per-write input and pre-commit output hash checks preserve concurrent user edits as CONFLICT; recovery never blindly overwrites different bytes
All persisted execution/rollback states, write-before-journal and pre-journal orphan staging have regression coverage; actual killed child is kept alive until SIGKILL then recovered
MCP session close cooperatively drains operations before releasing project locks and reaping its real Godot processes
Failure responses retain recovery operation ID/state; dev_loop separates attempted/planned paths from committed or unresolved changes
Git reverse patches mutate only a private disposable mirror before approval/journaled real writes; binary/link/mode/rename/copy patch variants are unsupported
Installation/setup tests now run actual scripts in separate temporary projects, never rebuild or configure the live workspace
limitations: T10 completion is not G2 or production qualification; T11-T15 and later gates remain pending
Human confirmation is provided by a trusted client; a malicious auto-accepting host is not detectable as non-human. Genuine desktop client/version UI acceptance remains NOT_RUN until T30
Legacy scene/text saves explicitly return validation:NOT_RUN; invalid Godot resource rejection remains D07 for T14
Journal v2 owner binding fails closed on experimental v1 journals; recover with the creating version before upgrade, no automatic adoption
No OS sandbox, multi-file filesystem atomicity, proven Windows directory/power-failure durability or arbitrary uncooperative-validator cancellation
Local library inspect/list/recover exist; independent CLI transaction management is not exposed

Earlier whole-suite installation/setup runs rewrote project-level MCP configuration in the live workspace and recompiled build output. This was discovered and isolated; existing configuration was preserved thereafter without speculative rollback. No global configuration was intentionally installed
Raw evidence is Git-ignored and must be rerun when unavailable; no commits, push, package publication or deployment performed
